text:
Hi everyone! 👋

​My partner and I are planning to get married online through the Utah online marriage process, and I was hoping to get some advice from anyone who has gone through this recently.

​We’d really appreciate your help with a few questions:

• Has anyone completed the Utah online wedding recently? How was your experience with the ceremony and overall timing?

•​ Which documents are required before applying on the Utah website? (e.g., apostilled birth certificates, marital status certificates, etc.)

• ​Post-wedding at Misrad HaPnim (Ministry of Interior): Once we receive the marriage certificate (with the Utah Apostille), what exact documents do we need to bring to Misrad HaPnim to register the marriage and update our status?

​Any tips, recent experiences, or things to keep in mind would be super helpful!

​Thanks a lot in advance for your help! 🙏
